text:
```yaml
name: Update MS Learn Dates
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'  # Daily at midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  update-dates:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Setup PowerShell
        uses: PowerShell/PowerShell@v1
        with:
          version: '7.x'

      - name: Update MS Learn dates
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Get current date in ISO format
          $currentDate = Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd"
          
          # Find and update all date placeholders in docs-mslearn
          $files = Get-ChildItem -Path "docs-mslearn" -Recurse -Include "*.md", "*.yml", "*.json"
          
          foreach ($file in $files) {
            $content = Get-Content -Path $file.FullName -Raw
            $updatedContent = $content -replace '(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})', $currentDate
            
            if ($content -ne $updatedContent) {
              Set-Content -Path $file.FullName -Value $updatedContent
              Write-Host "Updated date in $($file.FullName)"
            }
          }

      - name: Commit and push changes
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git add .
          git commit -m "Update MS Learn dates to $currentDate" || exit 0
          git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/main

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: success()
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "Update MS Learn dates to $currentDate"
          title: "Update MS Learn dates to $currentDate"
          body: "Automated update of MS Learn documentation dates to today's date."
          branch: "update-mslearn-dates-$currentDate"
          base: "main"
```
